payload.title: A cold agent in another repo could not find wake

payload.text: The first run filed into an unrelated project because that space had only one. Both the instructions and the CLAUDE.md block now say to create a project when none matches; a rerun created its own.

payload.reason: Verified by the cold-agent test: an agent given only a pricing-bug task, with wake never mentioned, filed the issue, logged its reasoning and closed it.
